description: a cone r 4 whose side face runs from its base circle down to its apex 4 below, bounded by the circle alone, the apex left implicit — no VERTEX_LOOP, no degenerate edge — as NIST's FTC-10 writes its drill points (faces #5417, #5569, #5986 and five more): the reader gives the face a vertex at the apex on the side it lies, and joins it by a seam as a VERTEX_LOOP's is. Shrunk from FTC-10 (ADR-0026 §4); Open CASCADE reads it, healed, to π·16·4/3
